svg.text: Where does the finite-shot uncertainty come from?
Variance attribution across the 276 qubit-wise-commuting measurement groups
Fixed PUCCSD(1) parameters · synthetic noisy Aer · 16 shots per group · one seed
Groups are ordered by variance contribution, largest first

svg.text: Tile position is variance rank, not a physical qubit or molecular orbital.
The first row encodes each group's standard error; the second encodes its share
of the summed estimator variance. Hover over any tile for its group index and values.
Group ordering is chosen only to expose uncertainty concentration.
How quickly the error budget accumulates
Measurement groups included, ranked by variance
Interpretation: equal shots per group did not produce equal
uncertainty contributions in this single synthetic run.
Synthetic depolarizing + readout Aer · 4,416 nominal shots · sampling uncertainty only · not IBM hardware
